ABOUT OUR HOTEL
We are located only 11 km from Keflav k International Airport, on the northern tip of the Reykjanes peninsula, in the town of Gar ur. It is a perfect location for your home base in Iceland or to spend your first or last night before taking off for new adventures. It is also ideal spot for a weekend getaway to Iceland.
Lighthouse Inn gives you a very calm and relaxing experience with everything what is best in Iceland just around the corner. ​
01
Choose A Room
Choose between our lovely and cosy Double Room (21m2) with two single beds, a bit bigger and more comfortable Double Room (26m2 with Disability Access ) and convenient Family Room (42m2) with 1 double and 2 single beds.
BOOK YOUR STAY
02
Have A Drink
Have a drink or two, coffee, tea or a snack in our 24-hours bar. Or play a snooker game or soccer with your friends in our chill our room opened whole day long.
03
Look Around
All the best of Iceland you can find around our hotel. Just look up in the winter sky if you want to experience magic Northern Lights show. Take a few minutes walk to the shore and look for whales. There they are. On your way experience raw Icelandic weather. This is an amazing place to watch birds. You may even spot puffins. First or last glimpse on the Sn fellsj kull volcano and a glacier which inspired Jules Verne to write " Journey to the center of the earth ". With a 30-40 minutes car drive you can experience more treasures of the Reykjanes Peninsula.

About | Lighthouse-Inn
top of page
WELCOME TO OUR HOTEL
Lighthouse Inn is a family run hotel. We are 3 brothers. We and our families live in Gardur. As this is the town we were born and raised, it is a great pleasure to be able to bring visitors to our beloved town. Together with our families we play an active role in the day to day tasks.
​
The hotel is built in a Finish log cabin style. It was mostly built by us with a few outside contractors lending a helping hand. Constrctruction started in spring of 2016 and the first guests arrived early 2017.
​
Our aim is to give each and every visitor a pleasant experience. We love all your reviews.
Please take a tour around to discover amazing spots just around the corner. All locals are proud of the Gardskagi area, the white shellsand beach and the lighthouses. And there is so much more to see.
Welcome to our beautiful hotel!

LOCATION
The Lighthouse Inn Hotel is located 10 km from Keflavik International Airport, at the very north of Reykjanes Peninsula, in the town of Gar ur (Gardur).
When you leave the airport on the first round about take the second right (pass first turn to Reykjavik) and then go straight ahead almost to the end of Peninsula.
You will see the hotel on your left hand side.
DETAILED DIRECTIONS
HOW TO GET HERE
01
By Car
99,99% of tourist arriving to Iceland rent a car. This is the most convenient way to travel. Most of the car rental companies offices are located around the Keflavik Airport. At Keflav k International airport there is a free Car rental shuttle bus. The shuttle bus runs every 15 minutes from the airport and runs to all the car rentals in the airport area. In the arrival hall there are clear signs that direct you to the shuttle bus waiting area. If your car rental company is located further away from the airport, please follow the instructions that you received on your rental confirmation.
02
By Taxi
You can also arrive to the hotel by taxi. There is a taxi parking right next to the airport building. Ask the taxi driver about approximate cost of this drive. Usually it's around 35-40 euros (5000ISK).
03
By Bicycle
You may think this is a joke. Believe it or not we sometimes have customers who travel around Iceland on their bikes regardless of the weather.
